retrievalProfile.description: A high-angle group portrait of four figures set against a vibrant red, finely-textured background with bold blue display typography at the top.

recipe.visualDefinition: A bird's-eye view photograph of a four-person group wearing saturated 80s-style clothing, positioned on a bright red surface with horizontal linear texture. The composition is anchored by a large, bold blue sans-serif title spanning the top edge.
coreVisualRelationships: High-angle perspective creating a sense of depth against a flat textured plane
Strong color contrast between the red background and blue typography
Staggered vertical arrangement of subjects leading the eye from bottom to top
Interaction between the subjects' direct gaze and the camera's overhead position
coreInvariants: Vibrant red background with fine horizontal ribbing or scanlines
Bold, heavy-weight blue sans-serif display type at the top

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four subjects staggered vertically in the center-left, appearing smaller due to the high-angle distance.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large blue title at the top provides a heavy horizontal anchor for the vertical subject arrangement.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the bold blue text, moves down through the staggered subjects, and follows the diagonal line of their placement.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive red textured space on the right side and between subjects creates a sense of isolation.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation across all elements with deep shadows under the subjects to ground them.
paletteRestrictions: Primary red and blue must remain dominant

composition.relationshipToImage: Overlays the background above the subjects

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family used in different scales for title and subtitle.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the sturdy, industrial feel of the display type.
Captures the geometric 80s new wave aesthetic.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-angle photograph of four people in 80s attire (yellow jacket, purple shirt, pink shirt, black suit) staggered on a vibrant red floor with fine horizontal linear texture. Ensure deep shadows fall directly beneath them.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, bold blue geometric sans-serif title in all caps across the top margin with tight tracking.

verificationChecks: Is the camera angle sufficiently high (bird's-eye)?
Is the red background textured with horizontal lines?
Is the blue text extra-bold and spanning the top?

adjustableVariables: Exact vertical spacing of the subjects
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original band members
Original band and album name text
postGenerationChecks: Check that the blue text is solid and legible against the red.
Ensure the high-angle perspective creates a distinct 'plunge' effect.
Verify the horizontal texture is visible but not distracting.
Confirm the subjects are looking up toward the camera.
recipe.reuseFormula: High-angle group portrait + [Color A] textured background + [Color B] bold sans-serif header.
